readout_other: Morris water maze; open field test; elevated plus maze; LFP power and theta-gamma phase-amplitude coupling in CA1, CA3 and mPFC; laser speckle contrast imaging; SVM classification
direction_notes: In normal rats LIFUS increased relative theta and gamma power in CA1 and CA3 during and for at least 40 min after stimulation. In BCCAO vascular dementia rats, 2 weeks of LIFUS restored reduced theta-gamma PAC and improved water maze performance and vascular branch number.

timing.protocol_description: 1-ms pulses at 25 ms repetition interval (40 Hz) in 10-s pulse trains repeated every 20 s for 10 min; in the VD+LIFUS group 10 min on each side daily for two weeks.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Due to the survival rate of the surgery was 65 %, 52 rats of VD group were randomly divided two subgroups, VD group (VD rats without LIFUS treatment, n = 26) and VD + LIFUS group (VD rats with LIFUS treatment, n = 26)
